### Gemini truncation uses wrong offset semantics **High Severity** `Compact` now routes Gemini data to `compactGemini`, but still pre-slices input with `transcript.SliceFromLine`. Gemini offsets are message-index based, not newline-based, so nonzero `StartLine` can cut the JSON blob mid-object. That makes `isGeminiFormat`/`json.Unmarshal` fail and can produce an empty or unparsable compact transcript.
Additional Locations (2) - [`cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/compact.go#L78-L79`](https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/8d90ed40b6087facc9e532e6dfc1c5ac24f02b80/cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/compact.go#L78-L79) - [`cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/gemini.go#L90-L93`](https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/8d90ed40b6087facc9e532e6dfc1c5ac24f02b80/cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/gemini.go#L90-L93)
